title: On the problem of assigning multiple interceptors over multiple aerial threats
summary: This article investigates the problem of assigning multiple identical interceptors over multiple identical aerial threats, where all interceptors are launched in a single salvo. For this problem, two strategies have been studied in the literature: (A) to spread all interceptors as evenly as possible over all threats, and (B) to randomly assign all interceptors over the threats. The main contributions of this article are as follows.
